استكرهن (form X)
# اِسْتَكْرَهْنَ (istakrahna) /is.tak.rah.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اُسْتُكْرِهْنَ (ustukrihna) /us.tuk.rih.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
# اِسْتَكْرِهْنَ (istakrihna) /is.tak.rih.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْرَهَ (istakraha)
